mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 AM, we are seeing 41 degrees with clear skies over Badger Prairie County Park under the New Moon.
The City of Verona is updating residents on the Mark Drive reconstruction project. Work on Phase 2 is currently underway, focusing on curbs, sidewalks, and preparing the roadway for asphalt.
There is plenty to do in town. Today, you can join trivia at Hop Haus, Wisconsin Brewing Company, or Paddy Mac's. Tomorrow, check out live music at Paddy Mac's or evening yoga at Insight Wellness.
In a report covering October 18 through October 24, police noted an incident on October 25 where a man was taken into custody for an O W I after being found stopped in an intersection.
Your flavor of the day is Chocolate Heath Crunch. Please note that the store is closed early this morning, but will open today at 10:00 AM.
